summary: 2026-27 home kit (blue, khokhloma-pattern sleeves). SPAR printed across the lower front (club's 2026-27 team presentation photo); MIR card patch on the right chest (club match-report photo, 24 Sep 2026). The oblast government and OMK are title partners on the club's partner feed, no shirt placement documented. Back, sleeves and shorts placements are unsourced: no kit launch or full-jersey photos found. The 2025/26 official replica carried an SBP chest patch and a Fonbet shoulder patch (club shop product photo); the 2026-27 game photos show the MIR patch instead of SBP and an unidentified yellow-and-black sponsor patch on the right shoulder.
